p0_policy.exit: All 17 gates passed with recorded evidence; no unresolved blocker can be deferred.
p0_policy.mapping_meaning: Each case maps to its primary feasibility gate; full case acceptance remains in its integration milestone. This mapping is not execution evidence.

gates.name: acceptance and measurable targets
gates.reason: Drift review resolved; targets frozen; real D150/E9 pinned with single reference CPU diagnostics. T50/R50, complete support matrix and qualification baseline protocol remain pending.

numeric_target_freeze.evidence: pancake/docs/performance-targets.json; initial engineering targets, not measuredperformance

real_corpus_qualification.reason: D150/E9 real input manifests pinned; T50/R50 unselected.

matched_reference_baseline.reason: Two diagnostic CPU jobs exist but do not meet frozen profile or sampling protocol.

gates.name: hardware and test access
gates.reason: Local M4 Pro and reachable existing Linux x86-64 RTX 3090 host identified; native runtime/GUI qualification pending. AMD/Intel/Windows and guest login unresolved.

gates.name: complete dependency/build graph
gates.reason: Three bounded candidate graphs failed cargo-deny. Final minimal patch-refreshed graph retains 30 duplicate groups and six unmaintained advisories; no candidate application dependencies adopted.

gates.name: safe resource and launch boundary
gates.reason: Safe tensor-backed API route identified statically; no custom kernel compiled/executed.

gates.name: real assurance compatibility
gates.reason: All empty-scaffold checks passed; real Slint/JIT assurance design unqualified.

gates.name: shared kernels on every runtime
gates.reason: Blocked prerequisites: viable adopted graph and required hardware; no runtimekernel battery.

gates.name: performance feasibility
gates.reason: Targets fixed and two single reference CPU diagnostic jobs available; no matched candidate, quality-equivalence or frozen-protocol performance qualification.

gates.name: closure review
gates.reason: No P0 closure or P1 authorization inferred from documentation/scaffold evidence.
